days.title: Summits and Highlands
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: El Alto de San Antonio
stops.detail: The protected natural area covers about 2298 hectares and includes the mountain alignment of El Alto de San Antonio, El Carrascal de la Fuente Roja, and La Teixereta.

stops.name: neveros
stops.detail: At its summit, remains of some prehistoric snowfields or wells intended to preserve snow can be found.

days.title: Sanctuary and Heritage Sites
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Cueva Helada
stops.detail: The Cueva Helada, very close to the Sanctuary of the Fuente Roja, proves the existence of the karstification processes commonly associated with this type of rock.

stops.name: ermita de Polop
stops.detail: There is another access from the CV-795 road that goes from Alcoy to Bañeres; near the Polop hermitage is the connection with the CV-797 road towards Font Roja.

stops.name: cavas
stops.detail: We find testimony of this trade in constructions of high architectural and ethnological value, such as the 'cavas' or snow wells.
